correctness.rationale: For m>=2, all real positive alpha, gamma-moment exponent differentiation gives EC, EH, and E(C P_j log P_j) explicitly; subtraction and digamma recurrence yield the boxed weighted covariance identity. Weighted pairwise polarization and psi'(x)>0 prove every term positive and characterize equality. A standalone checker matches two algebraically independent formulas with the raw gamma derivative on 1,360 integer vectors and performs four separate direct beta quadratures for asymmetric and symmetric noninteger examples. All boundary and normalization assumptions are stated.

value.rationale: Shannon and Gini–Simpson quantify complementary ecological diversity and Bayesian species uncertainty. This all-heterogeneous posterior dependence law is not recoverable from separate marginal first/second moments alone; the universal strict sign, sharp baseline, and iff symmetry equality are mathematically meaningful structural information for arbitrary positive posterior pseudo-counts.
